reason: In packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:141-143, checkIfIsAvailable computes both start and end identically from slotStartTime instead of computing end from slotEndTime (defined at line 99). Consequently, the end > workingHour.endTime check never inspects the slot's end time, so a slot starting within working hours but extending past workingHour.endTime is not rejected.
